payload.gloss: the corpus's first principle, cratylism: a concept's canonical sign is intrinsic and discovered, never coined. It is carried only by the cells whose laws apply it (those that name concepts by anchor, optimal sign or cold decode, and any agent declaring it as an engineering principle), never prepended to every projected cell, because a cell that does not use it would hold a host's own authored surfaces to this corpus's naming axiom. This repository's own sessions receive it through their project context, not through what ships.
